newFindings.title: Two full-suite E2E tests use a hardcoded moving anchor (2026-07-22) and fail when the wall-clock is not near it
failingTests: flow-mvp.spec.ts:1539 product IA v2 keeps discovery simple and saved execution clear
flow-mvp.spec.ts:3893 source-backed moving map saves one dated timeline into My Flow calendar
newFindings.rootCause: On origin/main these two tests fill the moving anchor with the literal 2026-07-22. With today = 2026-07-15 the moving timeline's current item becomes the D-7 item (7/15), so assertions expecting the D-30 first item or a 지난 할 일 bucket fail. The rendered app is correct for the date.
newFindings.alreadyFixedOnBranch: Commit 1aba5da 'test: make moving E2E fixtures date-independent' (on branch wip/worktree-consolidation-20260714, NOT in origin/main) replaces the literal anchor with createMovingDateFixture() = today + 10 days. Merging it removes both failures.
newFindings.productImpact: none (test-harness date fragility, not a product regression)
